requirement_text.ISS-0297: Fix landed at step-02 (commit 8eff8e1, rebased as 8eff8e1 onto latest main). This step verifies at real 16-way parallelism, closes the issue record, and merges.

task.description:
Run scripts/test_parallel.sh at real 16-way parallelism (TEST_PARALLEL_N=16 override on an 8-core host), confirm ISS-0297's two known failure modes (EngineConcurrencyTest pool exhaustion, AuditIssueClosuresTest gh-timeout) no longer occur, close docs/issues/ISS-0297.yaml as resolved, release the registry lock, close GH#596, and merge to main.

Steps 2 (fix design) and 4 (regression test / TEST-DESIGNER) of the standard WF-03 template were not run as separate gates for this specific fix: the change is two ExUnit @moduletag additions plus a matching --exclude flag in the parallel-runner script (no application logic changed, no new function/module/spec), and its correctness is measured directly and empirically by actually running the target scenario (real 16-way `scripts/test_parallel.sh`) rather than by a synthetic fail-then-pass unit test -- writing a unit test that fakes 'pool exhaustion under 16-way load' would not exercise the real mechanism the way running the real script does. This is the same class of judgment call the workflow doc's own 'regression test' section flags as needing adaptation when the natural verification is an end-to-end script run.
